ashby.first_party_role: temporal cross-check; not a same-instant authoritative total
ashby.temporal_drift: repeat observation before rejection; never merge asynchronous inventories into a synthetic total

lever.reconciliation: paginate skip/limit until terminal short page; jobs length == unique ids
lever.regional_instance: must be proven by first-party Lever-hosted careers evidence

smartrecruiters.reconciliation: stable totalFound; exhaustive offsets; unique ids == totalFound; detail company matches
smartrecruiters.temporal_drift: restart attempt if totalFound changes; never persist partial attempt

eightfold.reconciliation: exhaust pagination/cursor and require unique ids plus complete job invariant
eightfold.restriction: no certification from discovery metadata or third-party feeds; if no public authoritative inventory endpoint is proven, remain BLOCKED

auditcarriere.authority: first-party paginated HTML inventory plus visible total
auditcarriere.reconciliation: stable visible vacancy total; exhaust ?page=N until unique vacancy URLs == total
auditcarriere.detail_contract: each vacancy must have stable /vacature/ URL, nonempty title and summary; location/employer retained when exposed in JobPosting JSON-LD
auditcarriere.temporal_drift: restart/reject if visible total changes during pagination; never persist partial inventory

personio.authority: first-party complete public Personio XML feed
personio.reconciliation: every position id unique; full feed parsed; each first-party job title and live /job/{id}/apply link validated; jobs length equals feed positions
personio.zero_inventory: uncorroborated zero is not a green proof
personio.first_party_evidence: pinned Personio careers host and XML route; no slug guessing
